description: A JavaScript module providing an API client for communicating with the ATS backend, specifically handling resume matching requests and environment-specific base URL detection.

methods.name: detectBaseUrl()
methods.description: Determines the backend base URL based on environment variables, window location, or default localhost.

methods.name: normalizeError(err, fallbackMessage)
methods.description: Normalizes various error formats into a standard message and details object.

methods.name: postMatch({ file, jobDescription, signal, timeoutMs = 60000 })
methods.description: Sends a resume file and job description to the backend to obtain matching scores and feedback.
